scope: Read-only review and reductions of the retained Eq23 reference outputs; this note is the only authored file. No evaluator rerun, generated dataset, plot, solver, build or Git operation.

trace_equivalence.algebra: For D_mn=(d+2)*r_m*r_n/r2-delta_mn, trace(D)=2. Taking the trace of both raw and gradient-defect terms gives trace(H)=Lstar with w=2*V*d.dot(Cs*g)/(r2+eta), d=-r, and the same first gradient G.
trace_equivalence.required_matching: Same variant, neighbors, volumes, Cs, Eta and first-gradient construction. This is not an identity between Ci_Eta0 and Cavg_Eta2.
trace_equivalence.old_scalar_qualification: Descriptive roundoff/coordinate-reconstruction residual only; not a bitwise native replay or an accuracy gate. No old 2D scalar identity is asserted.
trace_equivalence.constant_isotropic_k: k:H=k*trace(H)=k*Lstar. The current scalar construction already contains the matching tensor trace; explicitly evaluating all tensor components alone adds no new constant-isotropic-k diffusion operator.

arithmetic_and_P1.interpretation: The defect term is necessary. Local P1 cancellation is consistent with M=I on these sampled rows; it does not establish P2 or a global operator property.

quadratic_response.measure: Frobenius norm of basis_response-I in the recorded Hessian-component basis; no engineering-shear factor. These are descriptive errors without an accuracy pass threshold.

2D_full_regular_receiver760_Ci_Eta0_exam.interpretation: An almost exact quadratic trace can coexist with incorrect individual Hessian components. Full Eq23-form evaluation is not P2 exact here.

Ci_Cavg_Eta_and_smooth_fields.interpretation: Ci and Cavg agree to roundoff in the fully regular complete-support examples. Cavg changes disturbed/truncated rows and can improve or worsen error; Eta2 also does not produce a uniform accuracy gain. Comparing variants is a discretization comparison, not a benefit caused by tensor storage.
Ci_Cavg_Eta_and_smooth_fields.boundary_qualification: The truncated 2D patch and 3D sphere cut are geometric support tests, not wall, drainage or coupled physical boundary models.

delivery_decision.constant_isotropic_k: Do not add full tensor storage or computation cost for constant isotropic k alone: the existing matching scalar Lstar already contains its trace.
delivery_decision.separate_future_work: Revisit variable or anisotropic permeability and robust boundary treatment separately, with their own discretization derivation and validation. No such implementation or admission is granted here.
delivery_decision.thresholds: Preserve all original test and physical-acceptance thresholds. The predeclared arithmetic model is unchanged; quadratic/smooth errors are reported without fitted acceptance gates.

limitations: Static local reference using current Wendland and h/dp=1.8; not the paper's cubic-kernel replication.
Only 2D Ci_Eta0 follows the literal printed D4 algebraic form with a substituted kernel. Cavg/Eta variants are modified comparisons.
3D D5 is a conditional dimension generalization, not literal paper 3D reproduction; no public 3D admission.
No global matrix, spectrum, conservation, pair symmetry, stability, convergence-order or general P2 proof.
No native production-call regression, time integration, benchmark or physical acceptance.
